_comment: Third-party libraries the VSA does not analyse (in addition to java.*, android.*, kotlin.*, etc. excluded in Main.configureSoot). Only generic UI, reactive, serialization and crypto-provider libraries; networking (okhttp3, netty), vendor SDKs (e.g. dji.*), maps and Google Play services stay in. javaCrypto.json only targets javax.crypto, so BouncyCastle internals are not needed.
_warning: Never exclude the app's own code. Its package can differ from the app id (com.rainbow.drone keeps its code in mobi.heyemoji.*): check the Application/Activity class names in the manifest before adding entries.
